cd src/components && python - <<'EOF'
import re
p='BarChart.tsx'; s=open(p,encoding='utf8').read()
s=s.replace("""// Drawn in CSS pixels so labels stay at caption size at every width.
const HEIGHT = 240;
""","""// Drawn in CSS pixels so labels stay at caption size at every size.
""")
s=s.replace("""  const [width, setWidth] = useState(600);
""","""  const [{ width, height: HEIGHT }, setSize] = useState({ width: 600, height: 240 });
""")
s=s.replace("""    const measure = () => setWidth(Math.max(Math.round(frame.clientWidth), 200));""","""    const measure = () =>
      setSize({ width: Math.max(Math.round(frame.clientWidth), 200), height: Math.max(Math.round(frame.clientHeight), 240) });""")
s=s.replace("""              width={width}
              height={HEIGHT}
""","")
open(p,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s)
